content: rhai 1.25.1 (2026-05-29, MSRV 1.66). Real built-in sandboxing: Engine::set_max_operations bounds total ops per eval, set_max_call_levels bounds recursion depth (default 64, 8 debug), plus max string/array/map size limits and disable_symbol to remove unsafe builtins; no file/network I/O unless host-registered. Syntax is Rust/JS-like and approachable for a filter/predicate DSL. The 'unchecked' feature strips all checks for speed and must NOT be enabled here.
